texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 14-Sale of unsafe food
texts.text: 14-Sale of unsafe food

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (1) A person must not sell food that the person knows is unsafe.
texts.text: A person must not sell food that the person knows is unsafe.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Maximum penalty:
texts.text: Maximum penalty:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (a) If the offender is a body corporate-$500 000.
texts.text: (a) If the offender is a body corporate-$500 000.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (b) If the offender is a natural person-$100 000 or imprisonment for four years.
texts.text: (b) If the offender is a natural person-$100 000 or imprisonment for four years.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (2) A person must not sell food that the person ought reasonably to know is unsafe.
texts.text: A person must not sell food that the person ought reasonably to know is unsafe.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Maximum penalty:
texts.text: Maximum penalty:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (a) If the offender is a body corporate-$375 000.
texts.text: (a) If the offender is a body corporate-$375 000.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (b) If the offender is a natural person-$75 000.
texts.text: (b) If the offender is a natural person-$75 000.

texts.orig: 15-False description of food
texts.text: 15-False description of food

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (1) A person must not cause food intended for sale to be falsely described if the person knows that a consumer of the food who relies on the description will, or is likely to, suffer physical harm.
